name: Cybercrime — Online Romance Scam (Estafa via Electronic Means)

fullText: Romance and investment scams conducted on social media or dating apps are prosecuted as estafa committed through information and communications technology, with the penalty one degree higher than ordinary estafa under RA 10175 §6. name: Cybercrime — Cyber Libel via Facebook or Social Media
fullText: Cyber libel is libel committed through a computer system. Under RA 10175 §4(c)(4) the penalty is one degree higher than ordinary libel (RPC Art. 355). Each repost or boost can be treated as a separate publication. Truth is a defense only if published with good motives. Prescriptive period is 15 years (Tolentino v. People). Preserve URL, post ID, timestamps, and witness accounts who saw the post.
